children.text: The competitors of Bubble Cup X gathered after the competition and discussed what is the best way to get to know the host country and its cities.
After exploring the map of Serbia for a while, the competitors came up with the following facts: the country has
cities which are indexed with numbers from
bi-directional roads that connect the cites. Each road has a weight (the time needed to cross that road). There are
teams at the Bubble Cup and the competitors came up with the following plan: each of the
teams will start their journey in one of the
cities, and some of the teams share the starting position.
They want to find the shortest time
, such that every team can move in these
minutes, and the number of different cities they end up in is at least

(because they will only get to know the cities they end up in). A team doesn't have to be on the move all the time, if they like it in a particular city, they can stay there and wait for the time to pass.
Please help the competitors to determine the shortest time
so it's possible for them to end up in at least
if that is impossible no matter how they move.
Note that there can exist multiple roads between some cities.

Three teams start from city 5, and two teams start from city 2. If they agree to move for 3 minutes, one possible situation would be the following: Two teams in city 2, one team in city 5, one team in city 3 , and one team in city 1. And we see that there are four different cities the teams end their journey at.
